Curated Media & Technical Walkthroughs

Watch these technical demonstrations before undertaking this week's workshop:

  • Visualizing Git DAGs and Branch Trees: Interactive demonstration of commit trees, detached HEAD states, and fast-forward vs. three-way merge resolution (18 mins).
